```{r load-packages}
library(gsm.kri)
library(gsm.core)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r simulate-data}
#### Simulate Vitals Data with Consecutive Repeats ####
# Site-level injection rates are intentionally extreme to produce realistic flag patterns.
# Flags require Z > 2 (flag=1) or Z > 3 (flag=2) via normal approximation vs. overall mean.
# Key insight: having many high-rate sites inflates the overall mean and suppresses Z-scores,
# so we use 1-2 extreme sites and keep most sites very clean.
set.seed(42)

n_visits <- 10
subjects <- paste0("S", sprintf("%03d", 1:120))
sites    <- paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", rep(1:12, each = 10)))

Mapped_SUBJ <- data.frame(subjid = subjects, invid = sites, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

vs_rows <- expand.grid(subjid = subjects, visit = 1:n_visits, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vs_rows$vs_dt  <- as.Date("2024-01-01") + (vs_rows$visit - 1) * 30
vs_rows$weight <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 75,   10),  1)
vs_rows$height <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 170,  10),  1)
vs_rows$bmi    <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 25,    4),  1)
vs_rows$sysbp  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 125,  15),  0)
vs_rows$diabp  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 80,   10),  0)
vs_rows$pulse  <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 72,   12),  0)
vs_rows$temp   <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 36.8,  0.4), 1)
vs_rows$resp   <- round(rnorm(nrow(vs_rows), 16,    3),  0)

site_map <- setNames(Mapped_SUBJ$invid, Mapped_SUBJ$subjid)

# Inject *consecutive* runs of identical values for each subject at a per-site rate.
# The metric only counts rolling windows in which all W values are identical, so scattered
# copies of a prior value do not score -- the run has to be at least W long.
inject_runs <- function(values, subjects, site_rates, site_map, window_length = 3) {
  for (subj in unique(subjects)) {
    idx <- which(subjects == subj)
    if (length(idx) < window_length) next
    if (stats::runif(1) > site_rates[[site_map[subj]]]) next

    # Run long enough to close at least one window, short enough to fit the visit schedule.
    run_len <- sample(window_length:min(window_length + 2, length(idx)), 1)
    start <- sample(seq_len(length(idx) - run_len + 1), 1)
    run_idx <- idx[start:(start + run_len - 1)]
    values[run_idx] <- values[run_idx[1]]
  }
  values
}

# Site run-injection rates — the share of subjects at each site that receive a repeat run.
# One extreme site per KRI measure (a different site each time) to get Flag=2 (red). The
# overdispersion correction in Analyze_NormalApprox requires a SINGLE extreme site (all
# others low) to produce Z > 3.
#
# weight — SITE01 is the problem site
weight_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# sysbp — SITE02 is the problem site (different from weight for visual variety)
sysbp_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.03, 0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# diabp — SITE03 is the problem site
diabp_rates <- as.list(setNames(
  c(0.03, 0.03, 0.90, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.03, 0.00, 0.00, 0.00),
  paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

# Other measures — mild background noise only
mild_rates <- as.list(setNames(rep(0.04, 12), paste0("SITE", sprintf("%02d", 1:12))))

vs_rows$weight <- inject_runs(vs_rows$weight, vs_rows$subjid, weight_rates, site_map)
vs_rows$height <- inject_runs(vs_rows$height, vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$bmi    <- inject_runs(vs_rows$bmi,    vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$sysbp  <- inject_runs(vs_rows$sysbp,  vs_rows$subjid, sysbp_rates,  site_map)
vs_rows$diabp  <- inject_runs(vs_rows$diabp,  vs_rows$subjid, diabp_rates,  site_map)
vs_rows$pulse  <- inject_runs(vs_rows$pulse,  vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$temp   <- inject_runs(vs_rows$temp,   vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)
vs_rows$resp   <- inject_runs(vs_rows$resp,   vs_rows$subjid, mild_rates,   site_map)

Mapped_VS <- vs_rows[, c("subjid", "vs_dt", "weight", "height", "bmi",
                          "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp")]
```

```{r compute-metrics}
#### Helper to run a repeat-measurement-rate pipeline ####
# Mirrors the kri0016-kri0018 workflow YAMLs: Count_Duplicates sums repeat windows over
# evaluable windows, then the standard rate pipeline scores and flags each site.
run_repeat_pipeline <- function(df, dfSubjects, strValueCol, strMetricID, strMetricLabel,
                                nWindowLength = 3) {
  windows <- Count_Duplicates(
    df = df, strSubjectCol = "subjid", strDateCol = "vs_dt", strValueCol = strValueCol,
    nWindowLength = nWindowLength
  )
  input <- gsm.core::Input_Rate(
    dfSubjects = dfSubjects, dfNumerator = windows, dfDenominator = windows,
    strSubjectCol = "subjid", strGroupCol = "invid", strGroupLevel = "Site",
    strNumeratorMethod = "Sum", strNumeratorCol = "IsRepeatWindow",
    strDenominatorMethod = "Sum", strDenominatorCol = "IsEvaluableWindow"
  )
  transformed <- gsm.core::Transform_Rate(input)
  analyzed    <- gsm.core::Analyze_NormalApprox(transformed, strType = "binary")
  flagged_out <- gsm.core::Flag_NormalApprox(analyzed, vThreshold = c(2, 3), vFlag = c(0, 1, 2))
  data.frame(
    GroupID    = flagged_out$GroupID,
    GroupLevel = flagged_out$GroupLevel,
    Numerator  = flagged_out$Numerator,
    Denominator = flagged_out$Denominator,
    Metric     = flagged_out$Metric,
    Score      = flagged_out$Score,
    Flag       = flagged_out$Flag,
    MetricID   = strMetricID,
    SnapshotDate = Sys.Date(),
    StudyID    = "SIM001",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

kri0016_results <- run_repeat_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "weight", "Analysis_kri0016", "Repeat Measurement Rate - Weight")
kri0017_results <- run_repeat_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "sysbp",  "Analysis_kri0017", "Repeat Measurement Rate - Systolic Blood Pressure")
kri0018_results <- run_repeat_pipeline(Mapped_VS, Mapped_SUBJ, "diabp",  "Analysis_kri0018", "Repeat Measurement Rate - Diastolic Blood Pressure")

dfReportingResults <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingResults[, names(kri0016_results)],
  kri0016_results,
  kri0017_results,
  kri0018_results
)

new_metrics <- data.frame(
  MetricID = c("Analysis_kri0016", "Analysis_kri0017", "Analysis_kri0018"),
  Metric   = c("Repeat Measurement Rate - Weight",
               "Repeat Measurement Rate - Systolic Blood Pressure",
               "Repeat Measurement Rate - Diastolic Blood Pressure"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
dfReportingMetrics <- rbind(
  gsm.core::reportingMetrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE],
  new_metrics[, intersect(names(gsm.core::reportingMetrics), names(new_metrics)), drop = FALSE]
)
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
#### Generate Repeat Measurements Report ####
w <- Report_RecordDuplication(
  dfMappedVS = Mapped_VS,
  dfMappedSUBJ = Mapped_SUBJ,
  vMeasuresVS = c("weight", "height", "bmi", "sysbp", "diabp", "pulse", "temp", "resp"),
  dfReportingResults = dfReportingResults,
  dfReportingMetrics = dfReportingMetrics,
  nWindowLength = 3,
  strGroupLevel = "Site"
)
w
```
